comparison.notes: NO REAL JOINT CLUSTERS: silhouette is weak and nearly flat in k (0.22-0.26 for k=2..8; best k=4 at 0.256), feature correlations are ~0 (|rho|<=0.10 except r~style_sr=-0.36), and the 3 verified factors are almost purely ADDITIVE (main-effects R2=0.0696 vs saturated 8-cell R2=0.0721, interaction gain 0.0024). k-means k=4 just rediscovers the marginals: one tall cluster, one wide cluster, and the short mass split by r/style; the only grouping not in the verified thresholds is the WIDE-object cluster, but its run-adjusted SR (0.475) is at grand mean (0.465), so it is not a prescription target. ARIs are low (kmeans~tree 0.211, kmeans~verified 0.258, tree~verified 0.312) because partitions cut the same marginals at different places. RECOMMENDED BUCKETS = the 8 CART leaves (R2=0.102 on run-demeaned success vs 0.072 for the verified 2x2x2, 0.060 for k-means): the tree lowers the tall threshold to h>0.142 (weakness starts earlier than 0.212), places the rim cut at r>0.70/0.76 (near verified 0.65), adds a genuinely new very-flat-object bucket (h<=0.029, SR 0.435 vs 0.609 for mid-height near-sink — the inverted-U in height), and uses style only inside the tall branch. Worst buckets: tall&hard-style 0.228, mid-tall&far 0.232, extreme-rim 0.212.
